lines: Bhavya Kapoor can sell up to ₹0.61 crore if all offered shares go; proceeds are up to that amount, not an estimate.
The offer for sale is recent: the trigger, shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, came 66 days ago.
Cash has been in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago), and the retained stake is an estimate of ₹1.42 crore at offer price.
Average cost of acquisition is unknown, so the gain cannot be assessed; holdings were found in one section only.
